acts.name: Prologue

quests.title: A Letter from Old Mara
quests.summary: A courier brought you a letter from someone called Old Mara. She has been watching you, and she thinks the village nearby is in danger. Go there and introduce yourself to the village elder.

quests.title: The Bell That Won't Ring
quests.summary: The village elder told you their bell was sold to a smiling stranger who paid 'twice its weight in gold'. Without a bell the village can't raise the alarm. Bring the smith iron and gold, then hang the new bell.

quests.title: Winter Stores
quests.summary: With the bell back, the farmer admits the granary is half empty: the same stranger bought their grain too, and winter is coming. Fill the stores, then tell the farmer. He has been worried about Tam the shepherd.

quests.title: The Shepherd's Path
quests.summary: Tam the shepherd never came home, and his sheep did. Something walks the hills at night. Wait for dark, fight off what comes, then bring Tam home and hear what happened to him.

quests.title: An Eye on the Chapel
quests.summary: Since Tam's story, the cleric has been frightened: someone painted a golden eye on the chapel door and left a note on the altar. Ask her what it says, then light the chapel with candles so the village feels safe there again.

quests.title: Raise the Watch
quests.summary: The eye on the chapel means someone is coming, and the village has no way to see them coming. The mason wants a watchtower so the guards can spot raiders on the hills. Ask him what he needs, then build it.

quests.title: The Market Road
quests.summary: From the new watchtower, the guards saw pillagers on the market road. The farmer still has to sell his harvest or the village has no money for winter. Escort his cart: talk to him, fight off the raiders, and meet the market elder.

quests.title: Gold at Double Weight
quests.summary: The smiling stranger is back in the village, buying gold and asking about people. He is the one behind the bell, the sheep, the eyes and the raiders. Hear him out, then let him walk or drive him out with steel.

quests.title: The Peddler's Debt
quests.summary: You killed the Peddler. His friends found a note on your door: 'He paid for you in advance.' Gold-Sworn enforcers have come to collect. Kill them before they hurt the village.

quests.title: The Pillager Moon
quests.summary: Whatever you did with the Peddler, the people who paid him are angry. The watchtower guards have seen a war party gathering. Warn the village, wait for nightfall, and hold the line until the last raider falls.

quests.title: Who Pays in Gold
quests.summary: The raiders carried gold they never looted, which means someone paid them to attack. Follow their tracks to a Pillager Camp (It Takes a Pillage), kill eight pillagers (patrols and outposts count too) and find their ledger in a barrel.
goals: Find and read: Ledger of Tithes

quests.title: The Peddler's Gift
quests.summary: You let the Peddler walk, and he left you a book of cult scripture. The village elder needs to know what the village is up against. Show it to her.

acts.name: Act I: Ashford

quests.title: Ashford Burns
quests.summary: The camp's ledger said 'Ashford. Tonight.' Mara's letter confirms it: the raid on the next village has already started. Kill the raiders and the Brand-Carrier, then find Reeve Halden in the ruins.

quests.title: What Was Left
quests.summary: Ashford's homes burned and its men were taken. The families who are left have no food, bedding or fuel. Bring bread, wool and coal, and give them to the survivors.

quests.title: Roof and Hearth
quests.summary: Halden won't let Ashford die. If the raiders come back, he wants them to find walls, not ashes. Ask him what to build, then help rebuild the homes.

quests.title: The Refugee Road
quests.summary: Two Ashford families are too afraid to stay. They want to move to your village, but the Faithful, the cult's warriors, are watching the road. Meet the families, protect them on the road, and see them settled.

quests.title: Beneath the Pipes
quests.summary: The Faithful talked about pipes, and Mara's note agrees: the cult moves its prisoners through old rusted pipes (a Cult of Azazel structure). Find the pipes and the keeper's log hidden in a barrel there.

quests.title: The Believer's House
quests.summary: The pipe-keeper's log says the prisoners were moved through a believer house (Cult of Azazel). Find it and talk to the Preacher who lives there. Zealots will come for him once he's talked: kill them, then read the ledger in the house's barrel to learn where Ashford's men are now.
goals: Find and read: Ledger of Ashford

quests.title: The Bastille
quests.summary: The ledger says Ashford's fourteen men are held in a Bastille, an illager fortress paid for with cult gold (It Takes a Pillage). Storm it: kill its legioners, archers and skirmishers.

quests.title: The Ravager's Horn
quests.summary: The Bastille's ravagers will run down anyone who escapes. Kill two ravagers and bring back a Ravager Horn (every ravager drops one), so Halden can hang it over Ashford's gate as proof.

quests.title: Open the Cells
quests.summary: You freed the prisoners who were left, but the Bastille's jailers are hunting them on the road home. Kill the jailers, then make sure the freed men reach a village safely.

quests.title: The Burning Door
quests.summary: The rest of Ashford's men were taken through a portal into the Nether. Build your own portal and follow them.

quests.title: Chains at the Fortress
quests.summary: The prisoners' trail leads to a Nether fortress. Find it, kill its wither skeletons, and bring whoever is still chained there back to the Overworld.

quests.title: Brother Vael
quests.summary: The freed men named the man who runs the cult's Nether trade: Brother Vael, a steward who buys gold, skulls and people. He is at the fortress. Hear what he has to say, then spare him or kill him.

quests.title: Tears for a Ward
quests.summary: Mara writes that the road ahead is long and you will need healing. She wants ghast tears brought to a cleric, who will brew regeneration for you.

quests.title: Night of the Faithful
quests.summary: You have broken the cult's prison, killed its jailers and robbed its trade. Now it has noticed you. Tonight the Faithful come for the village you protect. Hold it until dawn.

quests.title: One of Seven
quests.summary: The Faithful are dead and the village survived the night. Tell them it's over, for now.

quests.title: Vael's Map
quests.summary: Spared, Vael scratched a map of the cult's gold route into the netherrack. Its gold-runners carry cult money to the Sacred City. Kill them and the cult's carts run empty for a while.

quests.title: The Steward's Guard
quests.summary: Vael's death did not go unnoticed. His wither-guard wants revenge. Kill them before they reach you.

quests.title: The Invoker's Mansion
quests.summary: The freed men say the Bastille took its orders from the Invoker, an illager sorcerer (Illager Invasion) who lives in a Woodland Mansion in the dark forest. Find the mansion, cut through its guards and kill him.

acts.name: The Arcane Road

quests.title: The Priest's Warning
quests.summary: A village priest writes that the cult's Faithful are casting real spells now. To fight magic you have to learn it. Build an Inscription Table (Iron's Spells) and gather arcane essence.

quests.title: Fire in the Tower
quests.summary: The priest traced the cult's fire spells to a Pyromancer who sells them. Find his tower in the hills or forest and kill him.

quests.title: The Evoker Fort
quests.summary: The Pyromancer's ledger says the magic came from an Evoker Fort, where an Archevoker taught the cult to cast. Find the fort and end the lessons.

quests.title: The Scroll Forge
quests.summary: With the cult's teachers dead, the priest wants you ready for whatever comes next. Build a Scroll Forge so you can make spells of your own.

quests.title: The Dead King
quests.summary: With the Wither dead, the dead are restless, and the priest has traced it to the Catacombs. Something is waking under them. Find the Catacombs and kill the Dead King when he rises from his throne.

quests.title: The Mountain Tower
quests.summary: The Dead King's crown named him 'Champion of M. Second of seven. Failed.' His journal points to a mountain tower where a Cryomancer guards the notes of another failed champion. Find the tower and kill the Cryomancer.

quests.title: Echo of Tyros
quests.summary: The frozen notes say the god's oldest fire still burns: the Echo of Tyros, in a Nether Citadel. Find the Citadel and kill two Ancient Knights for Cinder Essence. Craft a Cinderous Soulcaller (4 Cinder Essence, 2 Netherite Scrap, the Echo Shard from the mountain tower) and ring it at the Citadel's glowing rune to summon Tyros. Then put him out.

quests.title: The Arcane Anvil
quests.summary: Two champions failed before you, and both died without magic in their steel. Build an Arcane Anvil so you can bind spells into your weapons before the End.

acts.name: Act II: The Withered Crown

quests.title: The Skull Market
quests.summary: Mara writes that the cult is buying wither skulls: three of them summon the Wither. Go to the Nether, find a fortress and the cult's price list in a barrel there, and find out who is buying.

quests.title: Smite the Dead
quests.summary: The cult wants the Wither. You'll be fighting the dead for a while, and the armourer can forge a weapon 'that hates the dead' if you bring blaze rods and bones.

quests.title: The Skull Harvest
quests.summary: Every wither skeleton you kill is a skull the cult can't harvest. Thin their numbers in the fortress, and kill the blazes that guard it.

quests.title: Hold the Black Bridge
quests.summary: The cult sends its Bone Choir to take the fortress back. Hold the bridge and kill the Choir-Master.

quests.title: A Grave for a Nail
quests.summary: Mara writes that the Wither is one of seven 'Wardens' the cult wants to control. If the cult raises it, it will serve them. Raise it yourself, far from any village, and kill it: four soul sand, three wither skulls, then fight.

quests.title: The Withered Crown
quests.summary: The Wither is dead. Bring its Nether Star out of the pit. You'll need it for the beacon.

quests.title: A Light They Cannot Dim
quests.summary: Turn the Wither's star into a beacon over your village, so everyone can see the cult did not win.

quests.title: Six Remain
quests.summary: Mara's last letter had a strange line in it. Read it to someone and see what they make of it.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG
leads: letter: A Light Above the Pit
letter: A Letter Smelling of Honey

quests.title: Two Roads Meet
quests.summary: Steel and spell: both roads led to the same name, the Chariot. Tell the elder you're ready for what comes next.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

acts.name: Act III: Hostile Paradise

quests.title: A Light Above the Pit
quests.summary: Villagers saw a beam of light rise from the Wither's pit into the clouds. Mara says to ignore it. The cleric's grandmother said glowstone and water open a door to heaven. Build an Aether portal.
leads: letter: questbook a very reasonable treasure map

quests.title: Hostile Paradise
quests.summary: You are in the Aether, a sky realm that should be full of light and is strangely empty. Gather what you need to survive: holystone, ambrosium and skyroot.

quests.title: Do You Believe in Magic?
quests.summary: The Aether's tools are made at an Altar. Build one and find Zanite for better gear.

quests.title: Cockatrice Nights
quests.summary: Without whoever used to rule the Aether, its beasts have gone wild. Thin the cockatrices and zephyrs so you can explore the dungeons.

quests.title: The Bronze Halls
quests.summary: The dungeons hold the Aether's history, and maybe the truth about the light from the pit. Find the Bronze Dungeon, clear its sentries and mimic, and kill the Slider in its heart.

quests.title: A Road of Cloud
quests.summary: The Aether's islands are far apart. Build a road of cold aercloud from your portal toward the dungeons so you never have to jump blind again.

quests.title: Medals of the Silver Court
quests.summary: The Silver Dungeon is the Valkyrie Queen's court. She only duels those with ten Victory Medals, and Valkyries drop one each. Find the dungeon, fight the Valkyries and the Queen, and read the hymn in its barrel.
goals: Find and read: The Hymn of Azriel

quests.title: A Cairn for the Valkyries
quests.summary: The Queen knew the truth about the Charioteer and kept it. Build a cairn of holystone bricks for the Valkyries who died for her.

quests.title: Extinguished
quests.summary: The hymn says the Sun Spirit threw Azriel the Charioteer and Maraal out of heaven. Find the Gold Dungeon and kill the Sun Spirit before it does the same to you.

quests.title: Fireproof
quests.summary: You came back with a name you can't stop thinking about: Maraal. Tell someone what you saw up there.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

acts.name: Act IV: The Edge of the World

quests.title: The Librarian's Request
quests.summary: A librarian who has studied the cult's Old Tongue for thirty years wants to help you find the End. She needs books and ink to copy what she finds.
leads: letter: questbook the house that owes me money

quests.title: The Road Underground
quests.summary: With all the eyes found, find a stronghold. The cult wants its library too and has sent Faithful and a hollow pilgrim to get there first.

quests.title: The Warden Journal
quests.summary: The cult was looking for a journal in the stronghold library. Find it in a barrel before they do.
goals: Find and read: The Warden Journal

quests.title: Free the End
quests.summary: Through the stronghold's portal is the End. The journal calls its dragon the second Warden. Kill it.

quests.title: The Edge of the World
quests.summary: Before you leave the End, find an End City and find out how far the cult reached.

quests.title: The Nether Is Singing
quests.summary: The librarian has finished copying the Warden journal and wants to talk about what it says.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

quests.title: The Road to the End
quests.summary: Two of Mara's champions failed before you. You've seen their bones. Tell the elder you're going on anyway.

quests.title: The Old Eye
quests.summary: The first eye, said to have belonged to one of the great Sandworms. Where: desert pyramids and dungeons.

quests.title: The Rogue Eye
quests.summary: The eye that taught our ancestors redstone. Where: jungle temples.

quests.title: The Cold Eye
quests.summary: Left behind by the Iceologers before they vanished. Where: igloo basements.

quests.title: The Black Eye
quests.summary: Pirates say it gave sight to a legendary ship. Where: buried treasure and shipwreck treasure.

quests.title: The Lost Eye
quests.summary: Forged by the first blacksmiths of time. Where: abandoned mineshafts and dungeons.

quests.title: The Corrupted Eye
quests.summary: The eye of a greedy king. The cult would love it. Where: pillager outposts.

quests.title: The Guardian Eye
quests.summary: It has watched warriors drown in the deep. Where: the Elder Guardian of an ocean monument.

quests.title: The Magical Eye
quests.summary: Without it, the Evoker has no power. Where: evokers and woodland mansions.

quests.title: The Nether Eye
quests.summary: Lost by a demon in the war between the Aether and the Nether. Where: Nether fortress chests.

quests.title: The Cursed Eye
quests.summary: The piglins swore to protect it with their lives. Where: bastion treasure rooms.

quests.title: The Wither Eye
quests.summary: It watched the Wither die. Did you keep it? Where: dropped by the Wither (summon another if you lost it).

quests.title: The Witch Eye
quests.summary: Craft it from a Witch Pupil. Where: witches drop pupils, then craft the eye.

quests.title: The Undead Eye
quests.summary: Craft it from an Undead Soul. Where: skeleton horses drop souls, then craft the eye.

acts.name: Act V: The Seven Wardens

quests.title: Cold Hearths
quests.summary: Mara writes that five more beasts stir, and asks you to start in the snow. A snowy village is freezing because its men won't leave the old garrison post. Bring coal and logs and talk to them.
leads: letter: questbook please return the ship

quests.title: The Frozen Garrison
quests.summary: The old garrison still patrols the Yeti Hideout in the snowy plains. Find it, lay the frozen soldiers to rest, kill Skor the Yeti (Bosses' Rise) and read the garrison roll in its barrel.

quests.title: Lost in the Snow
quests.summary: Skor is dead. Tell the snowy village their grandfathers can rest.

quests.title: The Buried Well
quests.summary: A desert village filled in its own well 'so the ground would stop breathing'. Their sick need milk, and the husks need clearing. Then tend the sick.

quests.title: The Nest Road
quests.summary: The husks are being herded toward the Sandworm Nest. Kill the Dune Faithful, find the nest and kill Sirok, the Sandworm.

quests.title: The Beast Below
quests.summary: Sirok is dead. Tell the desert village they can dig their well out.

quests.title: Nets and Knives
quests.summary: A fishing village won't sail past the black ship anchored offshore. Help them rebuild their dock so they can fish closer to shore.

quests.title: The Tidecaller
quests.summary: Drowned are coming up the beach at night, led by something that calls the tide. Hold the beach.

quests.title: The Black Ship
quests.summary: Board the Kraken Ship in the deep ocean. Kill its crossbowman, rook and captain, and the Kraken, Nerakyss, will rise. Kill it too.

quests.title: Terror of the Depths
quests.summary: Nerakyss is dead. Tell the fishing village the black ship is gone.

quests.title: The Soul Guard
quests.summary: In the Nether's wastes or soul sand valleys stands the Underworld Arena. Clear its soul guard and kill Helvar, the Underworld Knight who holds its gate.
goals: Defeat 3 x soul knight wither skeleton

quests.title: Helvar's Oath
quests.summary: Helvar couldn't speak. He left his oath written down in a barrel in the arena. Read it.

quests.title: Out of the Underworld
quests.summary: Leave the Nether. What Helvar wrote is going to follow you.

quests.title: The Last Road
quests.summary: Mara writes: 'The last one was his once. His mount.' Find the Dragon Tower, fight its skeleton guards, and kill Ashlord, the Infernal Dragon.
goals: Defeat 3 x flaming skeleton guard fireball
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

quests.title: Dragon Slayer
quests.summary: Bring Ashlord's bones home to show the smith. (They're given back.)

quests.title: Unbound
quests.summary: All seven Wardens are dead. Tell someone.

acts.name: Act V: The Underworld Arc

quests.title: A Note in the Stash
quests.summary: Mara writes that the Blackwater Cartel's drug money pays the cult's keepers in the snow, the sand and the sea. The only way to their Don is from inside. Grow a sample of weed (Create: Addictives) and find the Fixer, who is hiring growers.

quests.title: Seeds of the Trade
quests.summary: The Fixer wants a real operation, not a windowsill. Plant a field and fill an order.

quests.title: First Customers
quests.summary: A nervous buyer in another village wants rolled product, delivered by hand.

quests.title: The Hash Market
quests.summary: Hash moves faster and pays better. Set up your Create machines and fill the Fixer's order.

quests.title: Blackwater Wants a Word
quests.summary: The Blackwater Cartel runs this valley, and Blackwater is run by illagers. They've noticed a new grower.

quests.title: The Coca Fields
quests.summary: The Fixer wants to move into white. Plant coca and bring in a harvest.

quests.title: White Powder Money
quests.summary: Process the leaves and bring the Fixer his first big order.

quests.title: A Customer Goes Under
quests.summary: The nervous buyer's friend comes running: he took too much of what you sold and isn't waking up. Bring Narcan, fast. Afterwards his friend has something to say to you, and what you do about it decides whether you're still in this trade.

quests.title: Turf War
quests.summary: Blackwater is done being polite. Their crew is hitting your fields tonight.

quests.title: The Sorcerer's Books
quests.summary: Blackwater's accounts are kept by an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take the books.

quests.title: Crystal
quests.summary: The Fixer wants the one product Blackwater can't make: crystal. Nobody in the valley makes it purer.

quests.title: Purity
quests.summary: Blackwater has a cook of its own: a witch in a swamp hut they call the Chemist, who cuts her crystal with chalk and lye. Buyers are going blind on it, and blaming yours. The Fixer wants her gone, and he wants the valley to know whose product is clean: put her out of business, then bring him a bigger batch than she ever made.

quests.title: Don Vasco
quests.summary: Don Vasco, head of Blackwater, waits in the Labyrinth. Make him a partner, or make him an example.

quests.title: Remnants
quests.summary: Blackwater's survivors want revenge for their Don. Finish the war.

quests.title: The Big Shipment
quests.summary: With Blackwater as partners, the first joint shipment goes out. Fill your half.

quests.title: King of the Valley
quests.summary: You run the valley's green trade now. Show the Fixer what you've built.

quests.title: The Fixer's Price
quests.summary: The Fixer is gone, and so is half the strongbox. He left a letter: the Watch offered him a clean name for yours, and he took it. He's hiding with hired crossbows at a pillager outpost until the Watch comes to collect him. Get there first. Then decide what a man like that is worth.

quests.title: A Way Out
quests.summary: Reeve Halden knows what you've been growing. He also knows you've been doing good lately. He's offering one way out.

quests.title: Burn It Down
quests.summary: Getting out starts with the fields. The Watch needs to see them gone, every plant, so nobody can ever say you kept a stash for later. Tear up sixteen of your weed plants (plant more first if you've harvested them), then tell Halden it's done.

quests.title: Blackwater Sends Its Regards
quests.summary: Blackwater doesn't let growers retire. Their crew is coming tonight to remind you whose you are. Make sure they never deliver that message to anyone again.

quests.title: Testimony
quests.summary: Halden can't touch Blackwater without proof. Their books are kept by an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take the ledger and put it in Halden's hands. Your name is in it too. That's the price of getting out.

quests.title: A Generous Offer
quests.summary: A letter with a green wax seal: someone wants to meet you on the road. Blackwater has heard you're the kind of hero who can be talked to. Hear the offer. Take it, or refuse it in a way they'll remember.

quests.title: The Recruiter's Terms
quests.summary: You said yes. Blackwater wants proof you can grow: sixteen weed (Create: Addictives), handed to the Fixer.

quests.title: The Watch Needs Eyes
quests.summary: Halden writes that the Blackwater Cartel is poisoning the valley and paying a third of every emerald to the cult. The Watch can't get close. You can. Meet the Captain of the Watch.
goals: Talk to Captain of the Watch

quests.title: The Supply Line
quests.summary: Blackwater moves product through a pillager outpost. Break the runners there and take their manifest.

quests.title: The Bookkeeper
quests.summary: The manifest leads to Blackwater's bookkeeper: an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take his ledger. With it, the Watch can name every buyer, seller and bribed guard.

quests.title: Medicine for the Valley
quests.summary: The ledger lists the villages Blackwater sells to, and the cleric says three people there are already sick from it. Make Narcan (Create: Addictives) and bring it to the cleric before the raid.

quests.title: Don Vasco Answers
quests.summary: Don Vasco, head of Blackwater, waits in the Labyrinth. The Watch wants him alive to stand trial. Some in the valley would rather you didn't bother.

quests.title: The Valley Breathes
quests.summary: Blackwater is broken. Tell the Captain of the Watch.
goals: Talk to Captain of the Watch

acts.name: Act VI: The Sons of Sins

quests.title: Blood in the Wells
quests.summary: Mara says the cult will try to grow its god a new body in blood pits. Before you go, the librarian wants to show you what's been found in the well water. (Reward: a Sickle of Struggle. Hit creatures with it while carrying empty glass bottles and you catch their blood.)
leads: letter: questbook instructions for my own funeral
letter: questbook the man who came back warm
letter: questbook the man who buried himself

quests.title: The Sinful Church
quests.summary: The blood comes from a Sinful Church (Sons of Sins). Find it, kill the Devourers born in its blood, and read the recipe the cult is following in a barrel there.
goals: Find and read: The Midwife's Recipe

quests.title: The Midwife
quests.summary: The woman who runs the blood pits is at the church. Hear her out, then spare her or end her.

quests.title: Original Sin
quests.summary: The pits' failures crawl out at night as Betrayed Guzzlers, bloated things that drink livestock dry. Kill three.

quests.title: Jaws in the Dark
quests.summary: Villagers who drank from the wells are rising at night as Blood-Born. Hold the village until they stop.

quests.title: What Eats the Dead
quests.summary: To forge armour that can stand in front of a god you'll need Ether Ashes. Creatures killed while standing in blood, by a bone weapon (an Osseous sword or axe), leave ash. The church's blood pools work. Collect eight. (They're given back.)

quests.title: Soul Steel
quests.summary: Dip iron ingots into blood, or smelt Iron and Ether, to make Soul Steel. Craft a Soul Steel block and place it. Then craft the Remnant (Sinbuster) armour: the next chapter begins the first time its chestplate catches a heavy blow while you carry an Urn of ether ashes.

quests.title: Sinbuster
quests.summary: You wear the Sinbuster now: armour that can 'imprison attacks too brutal for the mortals'. Show the smith.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

quests.title: The Wrong Parcel
quests.summary: Mara's courier delivered the wrong bundle. Inside is the page torn from the Warden journal. Ask around about Old Mara.

quests.title: Maraal
quests.summary: She was waiting for you to find the page. Mara is Maraal. Hear her out, then forgive her or reject her.

quests.title: The Crimson Guide
quests.summary: Ghastlies, the crimson bees of the Nether, know the way to the Nether Mansion. Go below and tame one. The next chapter starts once one follows you.

quests.title: Cleansing the Pits
quests.summary: Spared, the Midwife shows you how to sour her blood pits: bury them under soul soil.

quests.title: The Coven
quests.summary: The Midwife's sisters come for you a day later. They want blood for blood.

quests.title: Walking with Maraal
quests.summary: You forgave her. She walks beside you and finally talks about the old days. Rest a night and listen.

quests.title: Alone
quests.summary: You rejected her. Her letters have stopped. You'll have to learn the Nether the hard way.

acts.name: Act VII: The Sacred City

quests.title: Follow the Crimson Bee
quests.summary: Your Ghastly hums north. Follow it to the Nether Mansion, the Cult of Azazel's Sacred City, and talk to the Welcomer who greets every pilgrim at its gate.

quests.title: The Cursed Quarries
quests.summary: Ashford's men are mining gold for a god in the Mansion's quarries. Kill the Manipulators who drive them.

quests.title: Hold the Quarry Gate
quests.summary: The freed prisoners need time to reach your portal. Hold the quarry gate against the piglin wardens.

quests.title: Gilded Hunger
quests.summary: In the Sacred City, Gilded Golems drink gold and blood. Kill three, then talk to the Doctor who was watching. He and the Blacksmith will trade with you.

quests.title: Do Not Provoke Gehinnom
quests.summary: The cult's guidebook says 'best not to provoke' the Gehinnom guardians. You have to, to reach the Lair.

quests.title: The Instruction
quests.summary: Reach Azazel's Lair at the end of the Mansion. A barrel there holds the instructions to summon him.
needs: this act's questlines from Mebahel's RPG

quests.title: Hand Over Your Weapon
quests.summary: Fight the Divine Chariot Azazel in his Lair. If you hand him a sword or axe he lets you live and you'll have to come back. Kill him and take his Staff of Manipulation.

quests.title: Half a Soul Cannot Die
quests.summary: A letter arrives the moment you're home. Read it to someone.

quests.title: Caution
quests.summary: The guidebook's trail: 'Pipes. Compass. Pillar. Head. Puzzle. Maze. Caution. Up. God?' Find the maze.

quests.title: Up
quests.summary: Above the maze waits the head altar, with 'God?' carved into the stone. Find it.
leads: The Choir of the Whole God

quests.title: The Choir of the Whole God
quests.summary: Everything the cult has left comes to the altar, to stop the reunion or to watch it. Kill them all.

acts.name: The Endings

quests.title: Bow at My Feet
quests.summary: 'Approach, beast, and bow at my feet.' This quest only completes if you accept his mercy and take his Cult Scroll. If you kill him instead, ignore it: his barrel holds a letter for you.

quests.title: Tithe of Gold
quests.summary: Gold is faith made solid. Bring the first tithe.

quests.title: The Last Preacher
quests.summary: He is whole now, so she can finally die. His first command: find Maraal.

quests.title: Maraal's Last Letter
quests.summary: He died whole. His last words, in the Old Tongue: 'Maraal, it's my fault...' Go home. Tell them.
needs: The Choir of the Whole God

quests.title: Ashford Rebuilt
quests.summary: Halden's son wants to rebuild the hall his father lost. Help him finish it.

acts.name: After the Ending

quests.title: Whispers of a New God
quests.summary: The god is dead, but his Sacred City is not empty. Halden has heard that someone is sitting on Azazel's throne and calling himself the Gilded One.

quests.title: The Pretender
quests.summary: Return to the Nether Mansion. Silas sits on the throne surrounded by gold-wardens. End his reign.

quests.title: The Last Faithful
quests.summary: The last of the Faithful kneel in front of the empty throne. Their leader asks you what they're supposed to do now.

quests.title: Morning
quests.summary: The throne is empty for good. Go home. Ring the bell.

quests.title: The First Command
quests.summary: Azazel is whole and you are his Hand. His first command: the beacon you lit over the village must go dark. It offends him.

quests.title: Ashford Must Kneel
quests.summary: Ashford refuses to tithe. Azazel wants their golems broken so they understand there is nothing left to protect them.

quests.title: Halden's Last Stand
quests.summary: Reeve Halden has come to stop you, alone, with his father's spear. He doesn't expect to win.

quests.title: The Hand of Azazel
quests.summary: The roads are yours. Bring your god his tithe, and take your place at his right hand.

acts.name: The Reputation Road

quests.title: The Prisoner
quests.summary: Reeve Halden's men caught one of the Ashford raiders alive: Orsk, the man who kept the raiders' tally. Ashford wants him dead. Halden wants you to decide, because you saved them. Hear Orsk out, then hand him over for judgment or execute him. From now on, the choices you make move you along a scale: Saint, Good, Wavering, Fallen, Wicked.

quests.title: The Granary Thief
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] You showed Orsk mercy, and Ashford is watching to see if you meant it. Someone has been stealing from the granary you filled before winter: Corwin, an Ashford refugee. Let him go and cover the loss yourself (you become a Saint), or punish him (you slip to Wavering).
leads: if killed: Ash on Your Hands

quests.title: The Assayer
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] You executed a bound man, and word travels. Morrow, an assayer for the Gilded Hand (the merchants who fund the Faithful), wants to hire you. Take his gold (you become Wicked), or cut him down (you climb back to Wavering).
leads: if killed: Ash on Your Hands

quests.title: The Lantern Oath
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] Halden heard what you did for Corwin. He wants you to take the old Watch-oath: keep the roads lit so no traveller walks in the dark. Hang twelve lanterns along the road, then walk a returning Ashford family home along it. Then a deserter from the raiders comes looking for you.
leads: if spared: No One Left Behind
if killed: Wardens of the Wall

quests.title: Ash on Your Hands
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Ashford knows what you did. The village elder says there is one way to start making it right: feed the families through the winter. Then a deserter from the raiders comes looking for you.
leads: if spared: Wardens of the Wall

quests.title: Protection Money
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Silas of the Gilded Hand has your first job: villages pay for protection now, and you are the protection. Trade or take until you have two dozen emeralds and bring them to Silas. Then he wants a deserter made an example of.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand
leads: if killed: Skulls for the Hand

quests.title: No One Left Behind
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The Bone Choir is hunting the last Ashford men who escaped into the Nether. Find the hunters at the fortress before they find them. On the way out you meet a scavenger with a wither skull.

quests.title: Wardens of the Wall
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] Things crawl out of Nether portals near the villages now. A guard captain asks you to help raise a wall facing the old portal. Then a scavenger with a wither skull asks for you.
leads: if killed: Penance in the Sky

quests.title: Wanted
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] There is a notice nailed to the well with your face on it, and a price. Bounty hunters come at night. Survive them. Then a scavenger with a wither skull finds you.
leads: if spared: Penance in the Sky

quests.title: Skulls for the Hand
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The Hand buys wither skulls for the Chariot, the same skulls you're hunting in the fortress. Sell Silas two. Then a scavenger turns up trying to sell the Hand a skull of his own.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

quests.title: Seeds of Heaven
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The cleric has heard that white apples from the Aether cure any poison. Ashford's children are still sick from the smoke. Bring her six. Then the old cleric, Sister Ysolde, asks to confess something.

quests.title: Petals for Medicine
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] The cleric wants Aechor petals: the plants bite, but the petals make a paste for wounds that won't close. Kill four Aechor plants in the Aether and bring her eight petals. Then the old cleric asks to confess something.

quests.title: Penance in the Sky
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The cleric says you can't pray your mistakes away, but you can work them off. She wants ambrosium from the Aether for the chapel lamps. Then the old cleric asks to confess something to you, of all people.

quests.title: Fall from Grace
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The burned farmer's barn went too. Skyroot from the Aether won't catch fire. Bring him thirty-two logs. Then the old cleric asks to see you.

quests.title: Gold from Heaven
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Silas has heard there is gold in the sky: golden amber from the Aether's golden oaks. Bring him sixteen. Then he wants the old cleric silenced: she knows who paid for the first golden eye.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

quests.title: The Librarian's Lamp
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The librarian is copying the Warden Journal and the Faithful know it. Assassins will come for her tonight. Stand guard until morning. One of the cult's scholars is caught with her copy.

quests.title: Messenger Pearls
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] Halden wants a faster way to warn the villages: ender pearls thrown from tower to tower. Bring him twelve. Then a cult scholar who stole the librarian's copy surrenders to you.

quests.title: A Letter Unanswered
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Mara's letters to you have gone short and careful. The librarian has one she was asked to read aloud. Then a cult scholar surrenders to you.
leads: if killed: Salt in the Wound

quests.title: Old Debts
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] Everyone you've wronged has a family. One of them has stopped hiring killers and come himself, with everyone he could pay. Survive. Then a cult scholar surrenders to you.

quests.title: The Lantern Watch
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] Halden has rebuilt Ashford's Watch, and the Watch is asking about you. Silas wants it broken before it learns anything. They patrol at night. Then Silas wants a runaway scholar dealt with.
leads: if spared: Salt in the Wound

quests.title: The Fisher's Debt
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The fishing village lost its boats to the Kraken. Without boats they starve. Bring them four boats. Then the harbour catches the wrecker who lit false lights on the rocks.

quests.title: Warm Hands
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] The snowy village is still short of fires. Campfires don't go out in the wind. Bring six. Then the harbour asks you to decide what happens to a captured wrecker.

quests.title: Cold Welcome
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The snowy village heard about you before you arrived. They won't trade until you prove you're here to help: clear twelve strays stalking their woodcutters. Then a captured wrecker is brought to you.
leads: if killed: Blood Calls to Blood

quests.title: Salt in the Wound
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] Drowned followed your trail to a fishing village and are coming up the shore tonight because of you. Stop them. Then the wrecker who called them is dragged in front of you.
leads: letter: A Note in the Stash

quests.title: The Harbour Tax
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The fishing village refuses to pay the Hand. Silas wants their iron golem dead as a lesson. Then he wants the wrecker who knows where the Hand's cargo went silenced.
leads: if spared: Blood Calls to Blood
letter: A Note in the Stash

quests.title: Hands That Heal
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The blood pits turned villagers into the shambling dead. The cleric can cure them with golden apples if someone brings four. Then a man who drank from the blood wells begs for help.

quests.title: Sanctuary
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] Families are fleeing the villages near the blood pits. Halden wants a safe house built in Ashford with four beds. Then a man who drank from the blood wells begs for help.
leads: if killed: The Freed Don't Thank You

quests.title: Amends
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] Halden sends for you. He wants to see whether you'll pay a debt nobody can make you pay: gold for the families of everyone who died since you came. Then a man sick on cult blood is brought to you.

quests.title: Blood Calls to Blood
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The Midwife's sisters can smell old blood on a person, and they smell it on you. Tonight they come. Then a man sick on cult blood finds you: he thinks you'll understand.
leads: if spared: The Freed Don't Thank You

quests.title: Blood Money
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The Hand has buyers for the cult's blood. Bring Silas four bottles (hit creatures with the Sickle of Struggle while carrying empty bottles), and hear who the Hand really serves. Then he wants a blood addict silenced.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

quests.title: The Lantern's End
quests.summary: The Siege: The whole Watch stands on the wall with you. Hold until the Hand breaks. Then: [Reputation: Saint] Halden has something for you before the end: the Lantern of Ashford, carried by the Watch for a hundred years. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

quests.title: The Freed Remember
quests.summary: The Siege: Half the Watch came. The other half is guarding the children. Hold. Then: [Reputation: Good] The men you freed from the quarries are walking home. One is too weak to make it alone. Walk him the last stretch. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

quests.title: The Freed Don't Thank You
quests.summary: The Siege: Nobody's sure whose side you're on. Only Halden stands with you. Hold anyway. Then: [Reputation: Wavering] The men freed from the quarries have heard stories about you. Halden's son wants to look you in the eye before he decides what you are. Then the freed men bring you the neighbour who sold them.

quests.title: Ash and Ember
quests.summary: The Siege: The Watch locked the gate on you. You fight outside the walls, alone. Then: [Reputation: Fallen] Before the end, the cleric wants a word. She has watched you make mistakes and pay for them. Then the freed men drag the neighbour who sold them in front of you.

quests.title: Golden Chains
quests.summary: The Siege: The siege isn't the Hand's. It's Ashford's. They've set their golems on you. Then: [Reputation: Wicked] The quarries are broken but their gold is still lying there. Carry four blocks out for Silas, and hear his last advice. Then he wants the neighbour who knows his name silenced.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

quests.title: The Lantern-Bearer
quests.summary: [Reputation: Saint] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

quests.title: Ashford's Friend
quests.summary: [Reputation: Good] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

quests.title: The Scales
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wavering] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

quests.title: What Remains
quests.summary: [Reputation: Fallen] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.

quests.title: The Gilded Throne
quests.summary: [Reputation: Wicked] The god is dead or crowned, and you are the one who decided. This is who the valley thinks you are. Go and hear it.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

acts.name: Choices That Come Back

quests.title: Free Men Remember
quests.summary: A letter from one of the men you freed from the Cursed Quarries. He's home in Ashford, and he'd like to see you.

quests.title: The Informant
quests.summary: The watch caught the man who sold the village's patrol times to the raiders: Wick, a pillager scout who lost his nerve. He says he knows who paid for the raid and will tell you, if he lives. Hear him out, then decide.
leads: if spared: Who Pays in Gold
letter if spared: Wick's Back Door

quests.title: The Lesson
quests.summary: You hanged Wick at the crossroads. The village elder wants to talk about what the children saw.

quests.title: Wick's Back Door
quests.summary: Wick kept his word. He writes that a Gold-Sworn wagon train is resting at a pillager outpost with stolen grain and two captives. He's left a gap in the palisade for you.

quests.title: Wick's Sister
quests.summary: A girl from the pillager camps has walked three days to find you. Wick was her brother. She doesn't want revenge. She wants to know why.

quests.title: The Bastille Warden
quests.summary: The Bastille's warden, Gorran, threw down his axe the moment the gate fell. He has the keys to the deep cells, and he says he only took the job because the cult holds his brothers. Decide what the keys are worth.
leads: if killed: Keys Off a Dead Man
letter if spared: The Warden's Debt

quests.title: Keys Off a Dead Man
quests.summary: You took the keys from Gorran's body. Ashford's survivors want to know who was guarding them.

quests.title: The Warden's Debt
quests.summary: Gorran writes from a village far from any prison. He guards their gate now, with a spear and no keys, and he has something to give you.

quests.title: Gorran's Brothers
quests.summary: The cult released Gorran's brothers to hunt you. They know what you did in the Bastille and they've come at night.

quests.title: The Third Skull
quests.summary: A piglin skull-trader, Ossian, has the third wither skull the cult needs. He'll sell it to whoever pays first. He is terrified of the cult, and more terrified of you.
leads: if spared: Hold the Black Bridge

quests.title: The Skull Remembers
quests.summary: You took the skull from a dead trader. Wither skeletons in the fortress smell it on you now.
leads: letter: The Choir Wants It Back

quests.title: Ossian's Gift
quests.summary: Ossian writes (badly, in gold ink) that he found his quiet place: a bastion the piglins abandoned. He left something there for the only fair customer he ever had.

quests.title: The Choir Wants It Back
quests.summary: The Bone Choir knows you killed Ossian for the third skull. They've crossed into the Overworld to take it back.

quests.title: The Pilgrim of the Sun
quests.summary: A pilgrim has climbed to the Aether to pray to the Sun Spirit you're about to kill. He begs you to spare it. He also carries a sunstone charm the cult would pay a fortune for.
leads: letter if spared: Sunlight in a Bottle

quests.title: Embers
quests.summary: The sunstone burns in your pack. Little flames follow you across the clouds.

quests.title: Sunlight in a Bottle
quests.summary: The pilgrim came down from the clouds. He's resting in a village and asked for you by description: 'the one who let me finish.'

quests.title: The Sun Remembers
quests.summary: Since you took the sunstone, things with wings follow you at night. Phantoms circle your roof and won't leave.

quests.title: The Last Garrison Man
quests.summary: One soldier of the frozen garrison is still alive: Brann, half-mad from cold, who led the Yeti's hunters to the village for food. He wants to go home. The snowy village wants him dead.
leads: if spared: Lost in the Snow
if killed: Snow on the Grave
letter if spared: Brann Comes Home

quests.title: Snow on the Grave
quests.summary: You ended Brann in the snow. Someone in the village should know.

quests.title: Brann Comes Home
quests.summary: Brann's wife writes. The village didn't hang him. It put him to work rebuilding the walls he helped break.

quests.title: A Widow's Letter
quests.summary: Brann's wife learned what happened in the snow. She wants his medal back. You have it.

quests.title: What the Last Page Said
quests.summary: The librarian has finished studying the Warden Journal you trusted her with. She found something on the last page the cult missed: where the Chariot's armour was forged.

quests.title: The Hand Reads Too
quests.summary: Silas of the Gilded Hand has read the Warden Journal you sold him. He's pleased, and paying a bonus, and he wants you to know the cult will be very interested in where he got it.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

quests.title: Tomas at the Gate
quests.summary: You sent Halden's son home instead of taking him into the Mansion. Halden has written to you about it.

quests.title: Vael's Last Letter
quests.summary: Brother Vael has been your spy inside the cult since you spared him. This is his last letter. The handwriting shakes.

quests.title: The Midwife's Daughter
quests.summary: The Midwife has been healing with the cleric since you sent her there. Her daughter, born in the blood pits, wants to meet the person who gave her mother a second life.
goals: Talk to Wren of the Pits

quests.title: The Lantern Road
quests.summary: Word of what you are has spread. The villages along the old road want to light it end to end, the way it was before the cult, and they want you to carry the first flame. Place twenty lanterns along the road out of your village.

quests.title: Silas Makes an Offer
quests.summary: Your name frightens people now, and Silas of the Gilded Hand has noticed. He wants to make you a partner. Meet him, hear him out, and take his first job: break a village's iron golem so it learns who protects it now.
goals: Talk to Silas of the Gilded Hand

acts.name: Lost Pages

quests.title: Lost Page 1: The Calling
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 2: The Wardens
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 3: Her Name
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 4: The Price
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 5: The Sea
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 6: The Cold
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 7: The Fall
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: Lost Page 8: The Grave
quests.summary: A loose page from the Warden Journal, written by Mara's first champion. It mentions a place. Go and see it.

quests.title: The First Champion
quests.summary: All eight pages found. The first champion asked to be buried 'where the old stones are, where the road used to be'. Find the trail ruins and pay your respects to the one who walked this road before you.

acts.name: The Bumblezone

quests.title: A Letter Smelling of Honey
quests.summary: Wren, a beekeeper, writes that since the light rose from the Wither's pit her bees have been flying into their nests and never coming out, and she thinks you can follow them. Go and meet her.

quests.title: Pearls and Patience
quests.summary: Wren will give you ender pearls to follow her bees, but first she wants honeycomb to seal her empty hives so new bees don't vanish too. Shear some bee nests (use a campfire under them so the bees stay calm).

quests.title: Into the Comb
quests.summary: You are inside the Bumblezone, a world of honeycomb, and the air smells of sugar. Wren will want proof. Mine honey crystal for its shards, and collect pollen puffs from the bees and pollen piles.

quests.title: Clogged Channels
quests.summary: Slimes have got into the honey channels and the bees can't get through them. Clear them out (slimes only: leave the bees and honey slimes alone).

quests.title: The Cell Maze
quests.summary: The swarm you freed is flying into a Cell Maze, a labyrinth of wax. Wren's bees might be inside. Find it.

quests.title: The Hive Temple
quests.summary: In the maze, Wren's bees were flying one way: toward a Hive Temple. Find it. The bees say a queen lives beyond.

quests.title: Roots That Bite
quests.summary: Rootmin, flower-headed things that spit at anything that walks past, are attacking the Queen's workers in the floral meadows. Clear a few out of the way.

quests.title: Audience with the Queen
quests.summary: The Bee Queen lives on top of a Throne Pillar. Find her. She doesn't speak, but she trades: hold out an item she wants and right-click her. Her first trade begins the next chapter.

quests.title: The Queen's Desire
quests.summary: You traded with the Queen, and now she has desires for you to fulfil (see 'The Queen's Desire' in your advancements). Complete any of them and she rewards you with Royal Jelly. Bring one bottle back for Wren. (You keep it.)

quests.title: The Honey Crown
quests.summary: Wren's bees are coming home: the Queen was gathering them for her brood, and she let them go for you. Tell Wren.

acts.name: Legionary

quests.title: The Golden Legion
quests.summary: Old Aurel, a retired soldier of the Ashford Watch, heard you are hunting in the Nether. He fought piglins in his youth and has a story about a warrior of theirs who could not die. Go and hear it.

quests.title: Ghosts of the Legion
quests.summary: Aurel says the Legion's last soldiers still guard the bastions: the piglin brutes. Prove you can stand against them before you face their champion.

quests.title: The Unbreakable
quests.summary: Find the Bastion Arena in the Nether wastes (Legionary). The Unbreakable sleeps in its golden tomb. Strike him with a netherite pickaxe to wake him, then break him.

quests.title: The Thermal Heart
quests.summary: The Unbreakable always drops his heart, a Thermal Stone. Bring it home and show Aurel. (You keep it.)

quests.title: The Unbreakable Head
quests.summary: Aurel says the first bastion treasure chest opened after the Unbreakable's death holds his head. Find it: it will be the proudest trophy in any hall. (You keep it.)

acts.name: Side Quests

quests.title: Lost Lambs
quests.summary: Tam's flock scattered the night he went missing. Bring three sheep back to the pen.

quests.title: The Bell's Tongue
quests.summary: The new bell needs a proper clapper. The bellmaker wants copper.

quests.title: Night Watch
quests.summary: The new watchtower saw torches on the ridge. A raid is coming. Hold the village.

quests.title: Safe to Market
quests.summary: A trader wants an escort to the next village. The road is no safer than it was.

quests.title: The Gold Collectors
quests.summary: Men who bought the Peddler's 'protection' are collecting payment. In blood if not gold.

quests.title: Ashford's Orphans
quests.summary: Children who lost their parents in the raid need food and warm clothes.

quests.title: Halden's Records
quests.summary: Halden wants the outpost that bought Ashford's men burned to the ground.

quests.title: Echoes in the Pipes
quests.summary: A miner swears the cult's pipes are whispering names. Go and listen.

quests.title: Ravager Hunt
quests.summary: Freed ravagers from the Bastille are trampling the fields.

quests.title: Bastille Survivors
quests.summary: A freed prisoner wants to go home to her own village.

quests.title: Quartz for the Cleric
quests.summary: The cleric wants Nether quartz to make wards against the Wither's curse.

quests.title: Blaze Bounty
quests.summary: The smith needs blaze rods to forge Smite-steel for the whole village guard.

quests.title: The Beacon Keeper
quests.summary: The village wants to raise the beacon's power. Iron, and lots of it.

quests.title: Sky Amber
quests.summary: The cleric heard of golden amber from the sky trees. She wants it for her medicines.

quests.title: Swet Trouble
quests.summary: Swets are sticking to the Aether's wildlife. Clear them.

quests.title: Ambrosium Lamps
quests.summary: The village wants lamps that burn with heaven's light.

quests.title: Ender Hunt
quests.summary: The librarian wants pearls to study the End's 'silence'.

quests.title: Copy the Journal
quests.summary: The librarian wants to make copies of the Warden Journal before something happens to it.

quests.title: Shulker Shells
quests.summary: The village builder wants shulker shells for storage that never forgets.

quests.title: Frost Patrol
quests.summary: The snowy village wants the strays that drift down from the hideout cleared.

quests.title: Husk Plague
quests.summary: The desert village is still overrun with husks from the nest.

quests.title: Drowned Nets
quests.summary: The fishing village can't cast a net without drowned climbing up it.

quests.title: The Pirate Hoard
quests.summary: The harbourmaster says the black ship's surviving crew are picking over shipwrecks for its lost cargo. Find a shipwreck and stop them.

quests.title: Soul Lanterns
quests.summary: Villagers want soul lanterns hung for the dead the Underworld Knight guarded.

quests.title: Ash Cleanup
quests.summary: The Dragon Tower's spawners still pour out Ashlord's skeleton guards, and they wander down to burn the farms. Go back to the tower and thin them out.

quests.title: The Blood Tithe
quests.summary: The cleric wants to study the cult's blood so she can cleanse the wells.

quests.title: Guzzler Hunt
quests.summary: Betrayed Guzzlers, bloated things the Sins left behind, crawl out at night and drink the livestock dry. Hunt them down.

quests.title: The Midwife's Debt
quests.summary: The Midwife you spared sends word: she wants to undo what she poured. She needs ash.

quests.title: Pay the Freed
quests.summary: The men freed from the Quarries mined gold for a god. They should be paid for it.

quests.title: Crimson Honey
quests.summary: The cleric wants Ghastly honey. She thinks it might heal the cursed.

quests.title: The Last Raid on Ashford
quests.summary: The cult's last raiders want to burn Ashford before the end. Hold it one more time.

acts.name: Secrets

quests.title: A Voice Under the Gold
quests.summary: The third shrine answered you. Not in any language you know: in the Old Tongue, the cult's own. One word, over and over. Write it down before it goes.

quests.title: The Name Before
quests.summary: The word is a name: the Chariot's name, from before the cult gave him another. A Believer's House would have it written somewhere, under the prayers. Find it, and find out why nobody says it.

quests.title: The Last Pilgrim
quests.summary: The pilgrim you fed knew your name. He is Oren, and long ago he taught a boy called Vael to count, before the cult taught Vael what to count. He asks one thing: light a candle where Vael kept his ledgers.

quests.title: What Oren Left
quests.summary: Oren was gone by morning. He left his bowl at your door and a note: 'Thank you. Whatever he became, he was a good boy once. Fill this for whoever walks the road next.'

quests.title: What the God Saw
